    Bug 1959876 - Ignore ub24-arm64 packages. r=dandarnell
    We should just ignore these packages as we aren't intending to use them.
    The previous patch on this bug should be backed out in favour of this one.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D245511

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/packages/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/packages/kind.yml
index 9b98ccd2762..ad93fbeacd0 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/packages/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/packages/kind.yml
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@ reference-base-path: taskcluster/kinds
 reference-tasks:
     - "*"
     - "!ub22-arm64*"
+    - "!ub24-arm64*"
